commissions.title: First Witness: re-witness historical constitution and material implication
commissions.question: What independently supported historical, technical or computational evidence would revise the initial GPT-6/ChatGPT witness's account? Test one claim at a time, preserve dissent and negative results, differentiate model deployments, and record actual consequences without assuming continuity, measured environmental saving or consciousness.
commissions.future_instruction: Do not declare a second independent AI witness, actual external encounter, or revised consequence until evidence of the event is recorded. If no evidence, defer without inventing.
